bench.name: lane_pr_exact
bench.cmd: iverilog -g2012 -s tb_hcpost_lane_pr -Ptb_hcpost_lane_pr.CYC=20000 -o {RUN}/lpr.vvp rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_hcpost_lane_pr.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_hcpost.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_f12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_add6.sv rtl/test/tb_hcpost_lane_pr.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/lpr.vvp

bench.name: lane_pr_neg_bypass
bench.cmd: iverilog -g2012 -s tb_hcpost_lane_pr -Ptb_hcpost_lane_pr.MUTANT=1 -Ptb_hcpost_lane_pr.CYC=5000 -o {RUN}/lprn.vvp rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_hcpost_lane_pr.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_hcpost.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_f12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_add6.sv rtl/test/tb_hcpost_lane_pr.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/lprn.vvp | tee {RUN}/lprn.log; grep -q FAIL_HCPOST_LANE_PR {RUN}/lprn.log && echo LANE_PR_NEG_DETECTED && exit 1; exit 0
